question: According to which ritual path should subsidiary liṅgas and related items be made?
premises: Subsidiary liṅgas and related items are to be made.
A specific path governs their making.
That path is the pure Śaiva path.
inference: Subsidiary liṅgas and related items should be made according to the pure Śaiva path.
plain_english: One should have the subsidiary liṅga and so forth made according to the pure Śaiva path.
